scope: Full five-moment hero IA/wireframe, functional states and local wording. Draft artifacts only; no review has taken place.
agenda: Walk UX-I-01..18 and every FX-00..19 state, including distinct correction approvals.
Confirm customer business wording, CP-01 emphasis, calm editorial direction and one dominant risk action.
Inspect local-vs-Azure/runtime labels; capture material questions in UXD, not inferred approval.
acceptanceCriteria: Five moments and all 18 interactions placed; no P1 dependency.
One understandable next action and truthful Prepared/Approved/Materialized wording.
Open material questions block acceptance; stakeholder product decision and human UX review are recorded.
requiredOutputs: Approved journey/IA, component inventory and actual initial mock when available.
Updates linked to UX-01/02 and MOCK-01/02; unresolved questions retained.
dueBy: M2 / GATE-UX01, after prerequisites are accepted

scope: Promise -> question -> options -> explicit design approval; FX-01..05 and real P02/P03.
agenda: Confirm missing intent/RPO remains consequential until explicitly answered.
Read A rejection and B recommendation; compare source catalog verdict and live explanation.
Inspect exact scope/hash and default demo-human limitation; compare approved mock with live projection.
acceptanceCriteria: User understands why A is rejected and what the exact design approval authorizes.
No eligibility or approval rule inference in UI.
Real promise/decision meaning and scope match approved mock; genuine model output is not replaced with fixtures.
requiredOutputs: Updated FX-01..05 and live P02/P03 comparison.
Bounded UXD fixes mapped to UI-02 and ENG-01/02, or human gate result.

scope: Prepared / approved / applying / materialized / error; real files and local delivery.
agenda: Read per-file diff and safe location; separate validation, delivery approval and local application.
Walk stale base/hash, build failure and conflict recovery with real diagnostics.
Ask operator to distinguish local files, Azure deployment and runtime proof.
acceptanceCriteria: Stale or failed change set cannot apply; only server-permitted recovery is offered.
Diff, local location and real errors are understandable and keyboard accessible.
requiredOutputs: FX-06..08/14/16 updates, application component mapping and LOC contract decisions.
Paired mock/live evidence and human review result; no automatic gate pass from build success.

scope: Risk/graph/ordered-list/away, correction and fresh scoped restoration. Early M0.5 feedback is not final acceptance.
agenda: Review impact, exact broken edge, binding/evidence gaps and observation limits without Scan.
Walk material approval -> delivery approval -> applying -> local receipt -> operator consent -> fresh verification.
Compare graph/list and away completed/failed/pending items; check keyboard, narrow layout and 200% zoom.
acceptanceCriteria: Proactive scene is understood without a manual scan.
Graph/list convey identical supported lineage and gaps accessibly.
No premature restoration; local correction or stale evidence cannot imply verified runtime.
Remaining unsupported promises are unknown; away reading is not approval or mark-seen.
requiredOutputs: UXD mappings to UI-04, INT-02 and ENG-03; genuine live evidence separately reviewed.
dueBy: Final GATE-UX04 after E2E-02-05; M0.5 review is advisory

scope: Three-question receipt, attention, evidence drawer and JSON/Markdown exports.
agenda: Answer Did we keep the promise? Did we deliver? What value did we create?
Compare mock-compatible/live source values and exported immutable receipt; inspect scope/as-of/origin.
Read missing savings and timing reasons, product attention and all separately disclosed operator work.
acceptanceCriteria: Same values in receipt UI, source snapshot and JSON/Markdown exports.
No fabricated financial benefit, fixed success count or unperformed live behavior.
Evidence freshness/origin/limitations are prominent and drawer focus works.
requiredOutputs: UXD mappings to UI-05 and ENG-04, with paired evidence and human review.

scope: All owners and stakeholder; complete approved mock versus real production hero.
agenda: Pair screenshots/interaction traces for all moments, recovered states, desktop/narrow and accessibility.
Review UXD disposition and final status/action/evidence/customer-impact semantics.
Accept benign cosmetic improvements explicitly; review real proof separately, never infer it from mock parity.
acceptanceCriteria: No unresolved blocker or material semantic/action/accessibility divergence.
Real proof is independently validated; mock origin never substitutes for live evidence.
Benign cosmetic differences do not block M9 unless they harm usability, trust, accessibility or hero meaning.
requiredOutputs: Human-approved design baseline, final component mapping and M9 sign-off.
Rehearsal package with paired evidence and retained UXD/version history.
